details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/server.py:28 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: hmac.compare_digest on str values raises TypeError when the X-Hub-Signature-256 header contains non-ASCII characters, so no 401 and no webhook_rejected log are produced.
  WHY: The request is still rejected (no auth bypass), but the error path is unhandled and unlogged.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/server.py:59-100 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The body is read before HMAC verification on an unbounded ThreadingHTTPServer, and the 10 s timeout is per socket operation, so trickling unauthenticated clients can pin handler threads.
  WHY: Thread exhaustion can starve legitimate webhooks (severity disagreement: sonnet-5_5 rated NIT with confidence 2; others MAJOR; highest used).
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:388-423 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _full_scan treats a listing of exactly scan_max_runs runs as complete and rebuilds self.queued from only those runs.
  WHY: Older queued do-runner jobs are dropped from demand, get no droplet, and trigger no queued_without_supply alert.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:189-423 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Completions are consumed before the job_annotations lookup, so an ApiError in _process_completions permanently drops the lost-runner re-run.
  WHY: Nothing retries it and the full scan only reads queued and in-progress runs (severity disagreement: NIT from sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash; MAJOR from the others; highest used).
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/github_app.py:117-120 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: job_annotations() needs the Checks:read App permission, which the README and docstring permission lists omit.
  WHY: Annotation reads return 403/404, so the lost-runner re-run (G6) never fires with the documented App setup.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/github_app.py:42-77 | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: GitHubApp caches a single installation ID and token and reuses them for all repositories.
  WHY: Repos under a different owner or installation fail with 401/403/404 and never get droplets (severity disagreement: BLOCKER from gemini; MAJOR from the others; highest used).
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:483-507 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A DigitalOcean create timeout is treated as a definite failure: the JIT runner is deleted and the droplet name is never recorded in self.created.
  WHY: A create that DigitalOcean accepted leaves an orphaned paid droplet and a duplicate create (severity disagreement: NIT from z-ai_glm-5_3-flash; MAJOR from the others; highest used).
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:237-243 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A droplet whose job ran but whose webhooks were missed is misclassified as boot_failed when its runner is still listed offline.
  WHY: False boot failures feed the circuit breaker, and three in the window can halt droplet creation for 15 minutes.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/__main__.py:31-34 | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The documented GitHub API budgets (about 1,700 and about 600 an hour, also in changelog.d/9722-runner-scaler.md line 23) ignore the full-scan fan-out; the worst case is about 3,400 calls an hour.
  WHY: Capacity planning is misled, and rate limiting can suppress creates (severity disagreement: NIT from sonnet-5_5, luna and glm; MAJOR from gemini and minimax; highest used).
- README.md:4784-4786 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The Rollback text says unsetting PIPELINE_RUNS_ON cancels and re-runs already queued do-runner jobs, but no code does that.
  WHY: Operators would expect queued jobs to be re-queued, but they stay waiting.
- .claude/commands/seed-repo.md:Step 6 item (c) part 2 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The fleet allowlist check compares a raw token count of RUNNER_SCALER_REPOS with the logged repos count, but _repos() normalizes the value.
  WHY: A correct redeploy can fail the equality check, stalling the setup before PIPELINE_RUNS_ON is set.
- .claude/commands/seed-repo.md:Step 6 item (c) part 1 | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The wait for user confirmation of the App install has no timeout, poll or fallback.
  WHY: The seed session can hang indefinitely, leaving the consumer half-configured.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Rollout step R3 must record the App Platform app under the resource name `runner-scaler` in the `## DigitalOcean resources` table, because /seed-repo looks for that row.
  expected_change_site: agents.d/9722-runner-scaler.md (fragment targeting `## DigitalOcean resources`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: agents.d/9722-runner-scaler.md only carries Workflow architecture and Stable log prefixes blocks, agents.md DigitalOcean resources table (lines 5091-5095) has no runner-scaler row, so /seed-repo Step 3 cannot confirm the fleet and Step 6 never offers item (c). Severity: BLOCKER (gemini), MAJOR (minimax, luna). Note: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly judged this a deferred requirement (rollout step R3), not a gap.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/server.py:signature_valid() | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: hmac.compare_digest on str raises TypeError for a non-ASCII X-Hub-Signature-256 header.
  WHY: No 401 and no webhook_rejected log; not an auth bypass.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:_full_scan() | severity=major | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A listing of exactly scan_max_runs runs is treated as complete and replaces self.queued.
  WHY: Older queued jobs are dropped from demand and from the queued_without_supply alert.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/reconcile.py:_process_completions() | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An ApiError on the annotations read after the completion is consumed drops the job with annotations_failed.
  WHY: A transient failure permanently loses the lost-runner re-run.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/github_app.py:job_annotations() | severity=major | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Documented App permissions omit Checks read, which the annotations endpoint requires.
  WHY: Every annotations read fails, so the lost-runner re-run (G6) never fires.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/server.py:Handler.do_POST | severity=nit | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The body is read before HMAC verification and the 10 s timeout is per socket operation.
  WHY: Trickling unauthenticated clients can hold threads, bounded by the 1 MiB cap and App Platform.
- tools/runner_scaler/runner_scaler/__main__.py:31-34 and changelog.d/9722-runner-scaler.md:23 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Stated API budgets ignore full-scan fan-out; the worst case is about 3,400 calls an hour.
  WHY: The documented numbers mislead capacity planning but stay under the 5,000 limit.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: no gap found; the runner-scaler DigitalOcean row is deferred to rollout step R3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
